issue.title: 2.1: Move CI (and engines) to Node 24 LTS (W3)

affected_files.role: Contains exactly 4 occurrences of node-version: '20' across lint, test, build, and release jobs (verified via grep -c, all in actions/setup-node@v4 steps)
engines.node currently '>=22' (verified line 61); already satisfies Node 24 LTS so the manifest may not need changes unless the team wants to tighten the floor

analysis.summary: All four jobs (lint, test, build, release) pin node-version: '20' in actions/setup-node@v4; engines.node is already '>=22', so moving the runtime to Node 24 is a single-file sweep on the workflow plus a possible engines tightening. Closes F-DEP-001.
analysis.details: Current implementation: ci.yml uses actions/setup-node@v4 with node-version: '20' and cache: 'npm' in each of the four jobs. Node 20 is past Active LTS and approaches Maintenance-only (EOL 2026-04-30). Node 24 is Active LTS through 2028-04-30. engines.node already declares '>=22', so the manifest does not block the bump; tightening to '>=24' is optional but worth doing to keep CI and local dev aligned. Verification: `grep -n 'node-version' .github/workflows/ci.yml` should show no '20' values, `npm run test:run` must pass at the recorded rate, and `node --version` in any CI log should be v24.x. Risk: native modules in devDependencies (canvas 3.x, sharp 0.35.x) typically have Node 24 prebuilt binaries by now; a build failure on `npm ci` would force fallback to Node 22 Maintenance LTS with a written rationale file as the issue body allows.

options.name: Bump all four jobs to Node 24 and tighten engines.node to >=24
options.summary: Replace '20' with '24' in each setup-node step and change engines.node from '>=22' to '>=24' so the manifest matches CI.
pros: Smallest diff for the dependency wave
cons: If canvas/sharp fail to install on Node 24, requires fallback
options.risk_details: Setup-node 24 is stable; the only real risk is a native module (canvas 3.2.0 or sharp 0.35.4) lacking Node 24 prebuilts, surfaced by a failed npm ci.

options.name: Bump to Node 24 with deferred-rationale fallback path
options.summary: Attempt Node 24; if the lockfile install fails on a native module, document the regression and pin to '22' Maintenance LTS in a docs/deferred-rationale.md note referenced from the workflow.

files_to_create.changes: only if Node 24 install fails; explains why 22 is pinned

pros: Acceptance criteria already permit this path
Lower coordination cost if a native module blocks
cons: Requires a manual gate before the fallback is finalized
options.risk_details: Same install risk as Option 1; mitigation is documented and pre-approved by the issue body.

history.note: no related commits in the modernization wave prefix; this is a fresh sweep

cross_references.note: #14 and #17 are declared dependencies and are merged per the orchestrator's dependency declarations; this issue runs after them.
